limitations: Uniform independent proposals of distinct k-subsets on a complete substrate; k tends to infinity and u=o(n). The critical law has no claimed uniform Kolmogorov rate, and no spatial RSA extension is established.
scientific_integrity: The infinite-array limits follow from the displayed analytic proof, not finite numerical testing. Pre-existing exact finite waiting-time formulas and abstract geometric-exponential laws are identified and credited. Historical priority remains open to independent scrutiny.
title: A sharp exponential-to-Gaussian crossover for growing-block adsorption near saturation
